description: This file implements the SyncAdapterDriver class, which is an Android activity managing synchronization adapters. It provides UI controls to bind, unbind, start sync, and cancel sync with various sync adapters. It also manages a cache of available sync adapters and handles user interactions for selecting accounts and initiating sync operations.

classes.name: SyncAdapterDriver
classes.description: An Android Activity class that manages synchronization adapters, providing UI controls to bind, unbind, start, and cancel sync operations. It maintains a cache of sync adapters, handles user selections, and manages the binding lifecycle with sync service components.

classes.name: SyncAdaptersCache
classes.description: A subclass of RegisteredServicesCache specialized for parsing and caching SyncAdapterType services, enabling dynamic discovery of sync adapters based on service attributes.

classes.name: MyServiceConnection
classes.description: An implementation of ServiceConnection and ISyncContext.Stub that manages connection to sync adapter services, handles binding, unbinding, and callbacks related to sync status updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and populates the list of available sync adapters.

methods.name: getSyncAdapters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sync adapters from the cache and updates the spinner UI.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the enabled state of UI buttons based on whether the service is bound.

methods.name: startSyncSelected
methods.description: Begins the sync process for the selected account and sync adapter, showing account selection dialog.

methods.name: startSync
methods.description: Initiates a sync operation with the specified account name.

methods.name: onServiceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the available services change; refreshes the adapter list.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user selection of an account from the list.

methods.name: initiateBind
methods.description: Binds the activity to the selected sync adapter service.

methods.name: initiateUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds from the currently bound sync adapter service.

methods.name: getSelectedSyncAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the user-selected sync adapter cache info.
